160.description: This feature vector represents French conjugated verb forms, particularly auxiliaries and common verbs indicating states of being, necessity, or possibility.

190.description: This feature vector represents concepts related to coastal, marine, and aquatic environments or geography.

100.description: This vector represents actions, transitions, or interruptions involving movement, breaks, and changes in state.

155.description: This vector represents words, prefixes, or substrings containing the letters "sur" related to surfing or the sound "sur".

27.description: This feature vector activates strongly on words and subwords containing the letter sequence "rupt" or related root forms associated with breaking, interruption, or specific morphological suffixes.

30.description: This feature vector activates strongly on French personal pronouns and related grammatical markers.

78.description: These tokens function as French modal, temporal, and conjunctive adverbs that modify verbs, adjectives, or entire clauses to express time, frequency, degree, or logical connection.

88.description: This feature vector represents words, prefixes, and abbreviations related to competition, sporting events, and the French interrogative or relative pronouns.

3.description: This vector represents common French derivational prefixes, root morphemes, and utility-related terms frequently found in technical or formal vocabulary.

86.description: This feature vector activates strongly on the French word root "qu" and words containing it, such as "qui," "quoi," and "quand."
